description: A line that fits gets no ellipsis.

florui.css: .p { width: 300px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; background-color: #e8ecff; color: #112233; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 6.78% of the pixels differ and the box is within 1px; what is left is the two engines' glyph antialiasing, as in the other text fixtures. Without the feature the same fixture measures 39.15% and the box is 210.0px off, so it fails.
